title: New vendor onboarding approval
description: Synthetic procurement policy for a fictional company: may this vendor be onboarded? Complete submissions with a clear sanctions screen and received tax form approve under the spend threshold; a screening match is a hard stop; large engagements go to the vendor risk committee. Synthetic content for demonstration; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Decide whether a proposed vendor may be onboarded, returned for more information, or rejected, once the submission, tax documentation, and sanctions screening have been assessed.
decision.question: May this vendor be onboarded?

evidenceRequirements.description: A dated record of a denied-party screening of the vendor's exact legal name against the public OFAC sanctions lists.
The vendor's completed tax form (W-9 or local equivalent).
The requesting team's written justification for the engagement.

sources.title: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control

citation.excerpt: Screening a counterparty against the SDN and consolidated lists is public and free; a match blocks the transaction pending review.

sources.rights: Public U.S. government data; cited as the screening source.

sources.title: Example vendor onboarding standard

citation.excerpt: A sanctions match is a hard stop. Complete submissions with received tax documentation approve below the committee threshold; at or above it, the vendor risk committee decides.

sources.rights: Invented content for demonstration; not an operational policy.

outcomes.label: Approve onboarding
outcomes.description: Complete, screened clear, documented, and under the committee threshold: onboard the vendor and record the engagement scope.

outcomes.label: Request more information
outcomes.description: Substantially valid but incomplete or awaiting documentation: return to the requester with the enumerated gaps.

outcomes.label: Reject
outcomes.description: A screening match or another criterion more information will not fix: reject with the reason recorded.

rules.description: Return the request when the submission is incomplete or the tax form is still pending.
rules.rationale: The standard returns incomplete or undocumented requests with enumerated gaps rather than deciding on them.

rules.description: Approve when the submission is complete, the tax form is received, the sanctions screen is clear and on file, and the annual spend is under the committee threshold.
rules.rationale: The standard approves complete, screened, documented engagements below the committee threshold.

exceptions.description: A denied-party screening match is a hard stop whatever else is true: reject, and route to the vendor risk committee.
At or above the annual spend threshold the vendor risk committee decides, not this pack.

escalation.message: Escalate to the vendor risk committee: state what is unknown or missing, quote the screening record if one exists, and do not onboard while the escalation is open.
